Why it doesn't fit its surroundings
What you would change about it

phrases.meaning: something very ugly to look at

phrases.phrase: stick out like a sore thumb

phrases.meaning: be much taller than things nearby

model: The building I find really ugly is a shopping centre near my parents' house in Quy Nhon. It's on the main road opposite a lovely old market, and next to a row of traditional two-storey shops. Honestly, it's an eyesore. It was built about fifteen years ago, and it's basically a huge grey concrete block with bright green glass windows and a giant advertising screen on the front. It towers over everything around it, so it really sticks out like a sore thumb. The problem isn't just the size. The colours completely clash with the old yellow buildings nearby, which have wooden shutters and tiled roofs. It's also in a state of disrepair now. Several of the windows are cracked, there are stains running down the walls, and half the shops inside are empty. It's definitely the least attractive building in the neighbourhood, and I think it's even uglier than most of the new towers in Ho Chi Minh City. The last time I walked past it, during Tet, I noticed that someone had tried to decorate it with lanterns, but it didn't really help. If it were up to me, I'd give it a facelift, maybe by painting it a warmer colour, adding some plants and making the ground floor more open, so that it would blend in with the rest of the street a bit better.
